title: Jiwa Nyang Phon Teudong .
intro: Jameun sigohlom na utusan jijak ateueh bumoe, sigohlom na kitab suci nyang jipeugah, na saboh makhlok nyang hana saban ngon makhlok nyang laen. Jiwa nyoe geubentuk le jaroe ilahi, geubri teumpat nyang lagak that, dan geu uji deungon cara nyang akan meugema lam mandum seujarah manusia. Nyang seulanjut jih na kheueh kisah leumoh, taubat nyang ikhlas, dan takdir nyang teuma ji-ubah jalan ciptaan keu siumu masa. Jeut neukira soe nyoe?
clues: Lon geubentuk le jaroe Nyang Maha Pengah nibak abée tanoh .
Lon geubri rumoh nyang hana meutandingan ngon lagak, dipat hana deuk atawa leumoh nyang hase jisentuh lon .
Lon peurintah bek sagai-sagai lon jak toe ngon saboh bak kayee pih, sabab nyan ka teularang .
Ulôn ngon sahbat keunong peungeut dan tapeutoë bak kayèë nyang geularang nyan, meulawan ngon peurintah Po teuh
Kamoe meugisa ubak Tuhan kamoe deungon meutobat nyang ikhlas, dan geupeu amphon keusalahan kamoe .
Nibak geutanjoë, bandum umat manusia meuturôn; Lon keuh nyang phon that jak ateuh bumoe nyoe .

trial.label: Sidang/Acara
options: Teungoh jitiek lam apui nyang raya .

outcome.label: Hasee
options: Geukirém u bumoe seubagoe peunjaga phon umat manusia .
Firaun ngon tantra gobnyan karam lam laôt .
Ié raya nyan jipeubinasa ureuëng jeuhet .
Apui nyan jeuet keu seujuk dan damé .
outcome.answer: Geukirém u bumoe seubagoe peunjaga phon umat manusia .

arabic: قَالَا رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَآ أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: They said, "Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers." (7:23)
